patchNotes: Google Play in-app updates now check automatically when ICARUS opens and resume interrupted installations.
Gemma 4 E2B is now the free, private, on-device default intelligence.
The APK stays small; the 2.58 GB model downloads separately over Wi-Fi from the official LiteRT community repository.
ICARUS verifies the model size and SHA-256 checksum before running it.
Local chat works without internet and has no per-message provider charge.
GPU acceleration falls back safely to CPU when the device GPU is incompatible.
DeepSeek remains available only when Cloud Intelligence is selected explicitly.
Web search remains an explicit cloud action because current information requires internet access.
Conversation titles are now generated locally without an extra AI request.
